title: The backlog section of the settings layers overrides backlog.json key by key, and backlog.py config names the layer and file of each value
goal: bl_base.load_settings reads backlog.json (or KB_BACKLOG_CONFIG's file), then merges the backlog object of kbsettings.effective over it key by key (group, clone, kb root, user), with the same type checks and refusals as backlog.json; a group-locked key is refused as kbsettings refuses it. backlog.py config prints each value's source as file, group, clone, root, user or default with the file's path, so a group changes forge, review_checks or trackers with no edit of the shipped backlog.json.

run:
import json,subprocess,sys,tempfile,pathlib
d=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); subprocess.run(["git","init","-q",str(d)],check=True)
(d/"backlog.json").write_text(json.dumps({"item_dir":"items","forge":"gitlab"}),encoding="utf-8")
(d/"settings.json").write_text(json.dumps({"backlog":{"forge":"github"}}),encoding="utf-8")
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/backlog.py","--root",str(d),"config"],capture_output=True,text=True)
line=[l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith("forge =")]
assert r.returncode==0 and line and "github" in line[0] and "clone" in line[0], (r.stdout,r.stderr)
